definitions.explanation: When compared to others or to what might be expected; somewhat.

⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{比較的|ひかくてき}⟦{暖|あたた}かい→暖かい：00618_atatakai⟧。
⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{比較的|ひかくてき}⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: This is a relatively safe area.

examples.english: He succeeded at a relatively young age.

notes:
USAGE: {比較的|ひかくてき} is primarily used as an adverb, modifying adjectives or verbs. It indicates that something is moderate compared to expectations or other cases.

NOUN: ⟦{比較|ひかく}→比較：03576_hikaku⟧ (comparison)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {比較的|ひかくてき}⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧／⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧ (relatively easy/difficult)
- {比較的|ひかくてき}⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧／⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ (relatively cheap/expensive)
- {比較的|ひかくてき}⟦{若|わか}い→若い：00823_wakai⟧ (relatively young)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦まあまあ→まあまあ：05430_maamaa⟧: So-so, moderately (more casual)
- ⟦わりと→割と：00420_warito⟧／⟦わりに→割に：16763_warini⟧: Rather, comparatively (casual)
- {比較的|ひかくてき}: Relatively (neutral/formal)
